subject: vt-u-pt
title: VT.U.PT.------POST.
description: First of two diagrams in MP(II)-30, the section on energy, political functionalism, and the coming change cycle. The prose immediately above the diagram names what the crossing actually does: 'every creative projection has insight as to the actualness of political functionalism. To view the nature underlying the coming change cycle is to view what factors are forming in both actual and vibrational (dynamic) terms, as well as how those factors relate to actual policy.' The crossing diagrams how the vibrational-universe particulars meet postulation in that policy-and-vibration relationship: VT-U-PT (vibrational-universe particulars — what creativity's vibrational dimension actually consists of) is crossed with POST (postulation — what political functionalism puts forward as its working claims). VT-U-PT sits centrally with the subject-arrow; A-PR (all-purpose) rises from the main line, WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle) branches from the A-PR line to the left margin, and UNI-PI drops from the WO-EXP-PRI line to the bottom-left. AF-NT (affinity nature) drops from the main line to the bottom, and CULT-SOLD (culture solidification) branches from the AF-NT line. POST sits at the upper-right as partner-axis; AFL-DY (affinity dynamics) branches from the main line to the right, and INDIV-TD (individual tendencies) branches from the AFL-DY line.
